description.narrative: The main activity in 2025 of the 2026.03.31 ECDD-GIRE Annual Report 2025 was the rollout of a digital‑supported capacity building approach (G50), including deployment of tools such as the WaterCoach app, tablets, IWRM e‑learning modules, and training content to strengthen local water governance and management. In parallel, the project implemented nature‑based solutions and 3R (Recharge, Retain en Reuse) water management interventions on the ground, such as reforestation, erosion control, small-scale water infrastructure and community works to improve both the quality and availability of water resources for local communities and agricultural production.
